sessions.phase_label: Logo concept development and iterative revision
Final asset delivery, troubleshooting, and rights documentation

requirements.title: Logo Name and Strapline Content
requirements.definition: The logo must identify the business as Global Dough, omit the word Truck, and retain the required Seriously Tasty Street Food strapline.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the required wording only; letterform styling, relative sizing, colour, and strapline presentation belong to the visual-design Requirement.

requirements.title: Logo Visual Design
requirements.definition: The logo must use the selected clean, legible, typography-led visual treatment, including the approved colour treatment, custom letterforms, restrained character, and any subtle graphic treatment.
requirements.boundary_note: Letter shapes, flame treatment, word sizing, colour gradients, strapline contrast, readability, and application versatility are attributes of one evolving visual composition rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Logo Concepts and Revision Process
requirements.definition: The designer must provide initial logo concepts and iteratively revise the selected directions in response to client feedback.
requirements.boundary_note: This is retained because the concept-and-revision output is an independently requested project deliverable; contract activation and routine review scheduling are excluded as administration.

requirements.title: Final Logo Variants
requirements.definition: The final package must include the agreed full-colour, black, and white logo variants and versions suitable for use with and without the black background box.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers distinct visual variants of the approved logo; file formats and whether delivered files open and display correctly are handled by the asset-package Requirement.

requirements.title: Usable Logo File Package
requirements.definition: The approved logo must be delivered in the required editable, vector, raster, and transparent-background formats suitable for print and digital use.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers file formats, transparency, accessibility, and correct display; it does not own the visual differences among colour or background variants.

requirements.title: Brand Colour Specification
requirements.definition: The client must receive usable documentation of the final brand colours and their colour codes.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers colour-reference information, not the application of colours within the logo itself and not a comprehensive brand-guidelines document.

requirements.title: Brand Font Guidance
requirements.definition: The client must receive details about the logo lettering and recommendations for complementary fonts usable in website headings and other brand materials.
requirements.boundary_note: Font guidance can be delivered and assessed independently of colour codes; comprehensive typography hierarchy or full brand guidelines are excluded.

requirements.title: Original Logo Artwork
requirements.definition: The final logo must be original work rather than stock, template-based, copyrighted, or AI-generated logo artwork.
requirements.boundary_note: Originality is a constraint on the created artwork; legal transfer of ownership and written evidence of that transfer are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Exclusive Intellectual Property Transfer
requirements.definition: Upon final payment, intellectual property rights in the final logo must transfer exclusively to the client so the client can pursue trademark registration.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the substantive ownership transfer; production of a separate certificate or written confirmation is independently deliverable documentation.

requirements.title: Copyright Transfer Certificate
requirements.definition: The designer must provide written documentation confirming assignment of copyright to the client, with wording that can be reviewed and retained for trademark-related records.
requirements.boundary_note: The certificate is a standalone documentation deliverable distinct from whether ownership legally transfers under the underlying project agreement.

requirements.title: Two-Week Completion Target
requirements.definition: The logo project should be completed within approximately two weeks of commissioning.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a task-local delivery constraint rather than a product behavior; the client's wording is approximate, so the precise deadline is not safely inferable.

unresolved_candidates.description: The client states that substantive design feedback is contained in an attached PowerPoint, but its contents are unavailable in the supplied evidence and may contain additional logo modifications.

The client requests written ownership confirmation while the freelancer treats preparation of a certificate as separately chargeable; the distinction between included ownership transfer and paid documentation should be preserved during event extraction.
